title: Rosalind and the Thorn
author: Hazel Almeida
blurb: Orsen Dunmore, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
